desc: Derive and verify the formula: \(\binom{n-1}{k} \cdot m \cdot (m-1)^{n-1-k}\), including \(m=1\), \(k=0\), and \(k=n-1\).
Implement `countGoodArrays` with modular factorials, inverse factorials, binomial computation, and modular exponentiation.
Validate the implementation against the three supplied examples and boundary cases.
